evidence: Initializes the caller's 32-bit output to -1; reads selector 0x13 and proceeds when its value is 3, 4, or 1, or is not 8. It resolves nested property key 0x2615c (0x20000|0x615c), obtains player_attribute_get_float selector 0x37, converts it to int32 and stores it, then resolves the same property and adds converted player_attribute_get_float selector 9. If the status guard fails, output remains -1. Body: decompiled/main/main_0124.c:24471-24528.

Initializes caller's 32-bit output to -1 and leaves it there if attribute_context_status_is_six_for_selector_0x13 returns true. Otherwise resolves the context object and indexed record, looks up its u32 field using global selector at 0x70045fa708+0xeb0, subtracts one, and for results 0..5 loads a u32 from the table at 0x7001d9e1d0+4*index; out-of-range results store zero. Body: decompiled/main/main_0124.c:29984-30007.

The body reads selector 0x13 and chooses mode 1 when its values are neither 3 nor 4 and its third read is nonzero; otherwise mode 7. It initializes an iterator, walks records with a limit of 0xab, looks up nested items and applies several index/value helpers, writing sentinel 0xffffffff and 0xffff fields on a matched branch. The item semantics remain unresolved, so no behavior name is proposed. Body: decompiled/main/main_0056.c:28415-28515. Indexed callers: decompiled/main/main_0058.c:5483-5527, 7428-7432, 27853-27857; decompiled/main/main_0070.c:17533-17537 (within load_roster_data); decompiled/main/main_0086.c:27067-27071.

Returns true when selector 0x13 is below 6. Otherwise, status 0 triggers callback dispatch; depending on callback return and object flags/pointers it can return true after the x0+0xc0 comparison and fields at +0x128/+0x130, or when the secondary callback state at +0x158/+0x160 is nonzero; otherwise false. Callers use the result as a boolean gate: decompiled/main/main_0071.c:2214-2215, 2963-2964; decompiled/main/main_0100.c:26820-26824; decompiled/main/main_0077.c:52617-52619, 52643-52647. Body: decompiled/main/main_0071.c:21533-21616.

Takes an object and inclusive upper index; iterates down through indexes, calling f_70006ec4d8(object,index,out) which emits a valid-record flag, a 16-bit sentinel/value, and status bytes. It skips invalid candidates, rejects when the candidate value is 0xffff, rechecks at the original upper index, and calls attribute_context_status_matches before returning a boolean. Callers pass an index loaded from object offset +0x32 and consume its return as a bool: decompiled/main/main_0053.c:23318-23326; decompiled/main/main_0058.c:42317-42321; decompiled/main/main_0053.c:47599-47660. Helper behavior: decompiled/main/main_0053.c:47374-47497; attribute_context_status_matches call: decompiled/main/main_0053.c:47642-47652.
